file_roles.evidence: logsToBeDeleted now holds (Log, scheduleTime) and deleteLogs sleeps until scheduleTime + fileDeleteDelayMs before removedLog.delete(), so a segment is no longer closed under a concurrent flush.

rationale: The trace is a ClosedChannelException in LogSegment.flush while the topic was being deleted, reported as a disk failure. The diff delays physical deletion by file.delete.delay.ms, which orders delete after flush.
notes: Log.scala and LogSegment.scala are cited from the stack trace; they are not in the packet diff.
